title: 飛行旅行
description: 搭乘飛機時的常用對話

sentences.en: Can I have a window seat, please?
sentences.zh: 可以給我靠窗的座位嗎？

sentences.en: We're experiencing some turbulence. Please fasten your seatbelt.
sentences.zh: 目前有亂流，請繫好安全帶。

sentences.en: What time are we expected to land?
sentences.zh: 我們預計什麼時候降落？

sentences.en: The flight has been delayed by two hours.
sentences.zh: 班機延誤了兩個小時。

sentences.en: I have a connecting flight to London.
sentences.zh: 我有一班轉機飛往倫敦。

sentences.en: Could I get a blanket, please?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一條毯子嗎？

sentences.en: How long is the flight?
sentences.zh: 飛行時間多長？

sentences.en: Please put your seat in the upright position for landing.
sentences.zh: 降落時請將椅背調直。

sentences.en: Is there an in-flight entertainment system?
sentences.zh: 有機上娛樂系統嗎？

sentences.en: We'll be serving dinner shortly after takeoff.
sentences.zh: 起飛後不久我們將供應晚餐。

sentences.en: Excuse me, can I recline my seat?
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我可以把椅背往後靠嗎？

sentences.en: The captain has turned off the seatbelt sign.
sentences.zh: 機長已關閉安全帶指示燈。

sentences.en: Would you like chicken or beef for your meal?
sentences.zh: 您的餐點要雞肉還是牛肉？

sentences.en: We're about to begin our descent.
sentences.zh: 我們即將開始下降。

sentences.en: My ears are popping because of the altitude.
sentences.zh: 因為高度變化，我的耳朵在發脹。

sentences.en: Can I use my laptop during the flight?
sentences.zh: 飛行途中可以用筆電嗎？

sentences.en: The overhead bin is full. Can you help me store my bag?
sentences.zh: 上方行李櫃滿了，可以幫我放包包嗎？

sentences.en: Please turn off all electronic devices for takeoff.
sentences.zh: 起飛時請關閉所有電子裝置。

sentences.en: I feel a bit airsick. Do you have a sick bag?
sentences.zh: 我有點暈機，有嘔吐袋嗎？

sentences.en: We've arrived at our destination. Welcome to Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 我們已抵達目的地。歡迎來到東京。

sentences.en: Is this a direct flight or does it make a stop?
sentences.zh: 這是直飛還是中途有停靠？

sentences.en: The flight attendant demonstrated the safety procedures.
sentences.zh: 空服員示範了安全程序。

sentences.en: Can I get some water, please?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一些水嗎？

sentences.en: We're flying at an altitude of thirty-five thousand feet.
sentences.zh: 我們正在三萬五千英尺的高度飛行。

sentences.en: I'd like to pre-order a special meal.
sentences.zh: 我想預訂特殊餐點。

sentences.en: My seat doesn't recline. Can I switch seats?
sentences.zh: 我的座位不能後躺，可以換位子嗎？

sentences.en: The plane is taxiing to the runway.
sentences.zh: 飛機正在滑行到跑道。

sentences.en: Please remain seated until the aircraft comes to a complete stop.
sentences.zh: 飛機完全停妥前請留在座位上。

sentences.en: I'm afraid of flying. Is turbulence dangerous?
sentences.zh: 我怕搭飛機。亂流危險嗎？

sentences.en: Do you sell duty-free items on this flight?
sentences.zh: 這班飛機上有賣免稅商品嗎？
